Super Speedy Performance Analysis

Free performance analysis for WordPress and WooCommerce. Finds which plugins are costing you SQL time, RAM and page speed, with evidence.

  • Analyse any page from the admin toolbar and see exactly where its time goes: request phases, per-plugin costs, slow queries, and function-level detail.
  • Deep Analysis isolates the real culprits by virtually disabling plugins for test requests only - visitors are never affected - and measures each suspect's true cost.
  • With the free excimer extension installed, every profile gains a function-level view that sees inside theme templates - the Tools tab generates the exact install commands for your server.

Function-level profiling guide
